title: Secrets
titleGold: inside the cluster, not in Git
lead: Applications fetch passwords straight from the protected vault.
leadBold: Every read stays in the audit log.
tokenHint: Tokens are issued by your Tuck administrator
errEmpty: Paste a token to sign in
errNetwork: The Tuck server is unreachable. Check the network and try again
errServer: The server could not verify the token. Try again later
clipboardDenied: The browser denied clipboard access. Paste the token manually (Ctrl+V)
hintIncomplete: The token looks incomplete: make sure you copied all of it
hintPrefix: Tuck tokens start with tuck_: make sure you pasted the right string

sealed.title: Vault sealed
sealed.text: Sign-in is unavailable until the key-share holders unseal the vault. Data stays encrypted, even from the administrator.

unseal.title: Enter a key shard
unseal.needTail: of the key. Each holder enters their own share separately.
unseal.autoHint: This vault unseals automatically (auto-unseal). Press the button to ask the server to unseal.
unseal.failed: Unseal failed: the server did not accept the shard

expired.title: Session
expired.lead: The token is no longer valid: it ran out or an administrator revoked it. Nothing is lost, just sign in again.
expired.invalidNote: The saved token was removed from this browser

sso.hint: You will be sent to your identity provider and brought back here after signing in
sso.note: Access is decided by your account's groups at the provider
sso.termWaiting: waiting to redirect to the provider…
sso.notConfigured: SSO sign-in has not been configured by an administrator yet
sso.throttled: Too many attempts. Try again later
sso.workingText: Verifying the provider's response and issuing a Tuck token.
sso.errState: No sign-in session found, or it has expired. Start again
sso.errInvalidState: The sign-in link has expired or was already used. Start again
sso.errCode: The provider rejected the authorization code. Start again
sso.errIdp: The provider is unavailable. Try again later
sso.errToken: The provider's response failed verification (signature, expiry, audience or nonce)
sso.errNoRole: Signed in, but no Tuck role matches your groups. Contact an administrator

ldap.hint: Use your corporate directory username and password
ldap.note: Access is determined by your directory group membership
ldap.noRole: Signed in, but none of your groups has a role in Tuck. Contact an administrator
ldap.notConfigured: LDAP sign-in has not been configured by an administrator yet
ldap.throttled: Too many failed attempts. Try again later
ldap.chooseNsHint: Your groups grant access in several namespaces. The token is issued for exactly one
